scope: Inventory of missing equipment identities from dungeon boss loot references not previously present in the main, Classic cache, Forever cache, leveling BiS or observed gear catalogues.
trust_policy: Metadata for ready rows reflects a Forever beta-server 70058 community snapshot; not an observed player drop, a proven live-game item or a promise of accessibility. Original boss reference remains Classic-only unless its source explicitly documents the boss-item pair for Forever. Rates, when provided, are clearly marked Classic 1.12. Missing fields remain null; pending rows are excluded from the public equipment catalogue. Additional 42 profiles are sourced item-by-item to ForeverChanges beta records reviewed 2026-10-19. Per-boss rate mentions without explicit Classic labelling are community estimates, never validated Forever drop percentages. Viridian Band has no supported Cookie attribution. Conflicting Ghamoo-ra rates deliberately remain undisplayed.
